object.attr: analysis: review Q44. The Inspector's incoming links would otherwise stay old with no mark. Decided on 2026-11-11, to confirm. MELLON-TRACE-SRS-39 works incoming links out afresh when they are shown.
object.description: When a Document Editor is activated after a change on disk to another document adds or removes a link to the document, the Document Editor should show the Changed on disk banner.
